title: mcp objects
description: Shared definitions of the session platform API (03-api.md section 8).

input_get_whiteboard.description: task_id is required for level task and refused for the levels org and workgroup; the guest and the runner check this rule (a tool input schema is a plain object: the model API refuses oneOf, anyOf and allOf at its top level)

type.description: operation type; an unknown or malformed type is recorded and rejected (unknown_type)

params.description: parameters of the type; checked against ops/<type>.params.json (an unknown type or invalid parameters are recorded and answered with status rejected)

wait_seconds.description: seconds to wait for a final state (at most 30)
seconds to wait for a final state (at most 30)

output_list_workgroups.description: my_access null: the task owner has no access to that workgroup

idempotency_key.description: optional client key that marks a repetition as the same request; it never lifts the duplicate rule of an operation type with dedupe fields, and reusing it there for other content is params_invalid

oneOf.description: result of the original operation (duplicate_of), or of an existing open pull request found by the executor (no duplicate_of, result.existing true)
not final within the wait time; duplicate_of when the original is still running

tool_error.description: isError result body: closed code list (decisions CTR-02) and an English sentence

notice.description: ping notice of 03-api.md section 8.2; kinds distinct, in the order whiteboard.entry, subagent.finished, operation.finished
notice.pattern: ^agent\.dfx\.swiss notice: [1-9][0-9]{0,5} new item\(s\) available \((whiteboard\.entry, subagent\.finished, operation\.finished|whiteboard\.entry, subagent\.finished|whiteboard\.entry, operation\.finished|whiteboard\.entry|subagent\.finished, operation\.finished|subagent\.finished|operation\.finished)\)\. Use mcp__platform__get_notifications to see them\.$

session_notice.description: platform session notice of a resumed or restored session (ADR-072 section 7, 05-runner.md section 5.5): what changed and the current session facts, attached once to the first decorated hook answer after the resume; a ping notice may follow after a blank line

hook_context.description: additionalContext of a decorated hook answer: a ping notice, a session notice, or a session notice followed by a ping notice

enum: This tool is forbidden in agent.dfx.swiss sessions. Request actions through the platform tools (mcp__platform__request_operation).
Glob and Grep patterns must stay inside the workspace: no leading / or ~, no .. segment and no NUL character.

anyOf.pattern: ^Tool [A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128} is forbidden in agent\.dfx\.swiss sessions\. Request actions through the platform tools \(mcp__platform__request_operation\)\.$

workvm_job_id.description: ID of a job in the work VM

command.description: run as /bin/bash -lc COMMAND as root in the work VM

cwd.description: absolute working directory in the VM (default /workspace, the mirror of the workspace)

env.description: extra environment variables of the command

stdin.description: text given to the command on stdin (absent: empty)

timeout_seconds.description: end the job after this many seconds (absent: no limit)

wait_seconds.description: seconds to wait for output or the end (at most 30)

sync.description: to_vm (default): mirror the changed files of the workspace into /workspace first

offset.description: byte offset to read from (absent: the tail)

wait_seconds.description: seconds to wait for output or the end (at most 30)

output_workvm_exec.description: a job of the work VM (13-work-vm.md section 3)

output_workvm_kill.description: a job of the work VM (13-work-vm.md section 3)
